curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: recognise straight and curved lines from real objects in the environment.

mission.title: recognise straight and curved lines from real objects in the environment.

choices.label: Straight line
choices.accessibleDescription: a line that goes straight without bending

interactions.feedback: Yes! A straight line does not bend.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the line that goes straight across.

interactions.prompt: Match each object to its line.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an object, then tap its line word.
interactions.feedback: Great! A ruler is straight and a banana is curved.
interactions.retryHint: Ask: does the object bend or stay straight?

interactions.prompt: Put the objects in the straight or curved basket.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an object, then tap the straight or curved basket.
interactions.feedback: Well done! You found lines on every object.
interactions.retryHint: Straight objects do not turn. Curved ones bend around.

interactions.prompt: At home, which object has a curved line? Tap it.

choices.label: Plate rim
choices.accessibleDescription: a round plate with a curved edge

choices.label: Table edge
choices.accessibleDescription: a table with a straight edge

choices.label: Ruler
choices.accessibleDescription: a ruler with a straight edge

interactions.feedback: Correct! The round plate rim makes a curved line.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the object with a round edge.

interactions.prompt: On the school walk, sort the line clues.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each clue, then tap straight or curved.
interactions.retryHint: A rail and window side go straight. A bend turns around.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Match the real objects to their line.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an object, then tap straight or curved.
interactions.feedback: You did it! You can spot straight and curved lines around you.
interactions.retryHint: Look for objects that stay straight and objects that bend.
